info.name: Temporal Shunt
info.description: Temporal Shunt (Explorer's Guide to Wildemount) — added locally, not part of the core 2024 pack.
info.author: Falling-Cats

description.p: You target the triggering creature, which must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or vanish, thrown to another point in time and causing its attack to miss or its spell to be wasted.
At the start of its next turn, the target reappears where it was, or in the closest unoccupied space. It doesn't remember you casting the spell or being affected by it.

Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 6th level or higher, you can target one additional creature for each slot level above 5th. All targets must be within 30 feet of each other.

setters.set: wisdom, save, banishment, upcasting, higher-level spell slot
Reaction, which you take when a creature you can see makes an attack roll or starts casting a spell
